While on a Strand subclass or with certain exotics, a Strand debuffed enemy [Sever/Unravel/Suspend] creates a Tangle upon death [12s cooldown]

Fastball [Arms] increases height/distance of thrown grenades by 25%
Firepower [Arms] spawns 1 small Orb of Power on Grenade Kill
Momentum Transfer [Arms] grants 12% [17%] {20%} Melee energy on grenade hit (7 sec cooldown)
Bolstering Detonation [Arms] grants 12% [17%] {20%} Class Ability energy on grenade hit (7 sec cooldown)
